evidence_role: uncalibrated conditional forward; not verified emissions or a forecast

son.zero_identity: explicit spinup initial scenario, not measured absence
son.evidence: SWAT2009 3:1.1.2-4; adapted initialization, modern geography held only as initial density

land1_integration.identity: fixed active support for LAND1: land slot 4 and unresolved slot 12 inactive; scientific support scenario

manure.evidence: Pinned mHM-Nitrate Selke crops.txt manfIN=0.5 and crop resfast=0.6; applying resfast to manure organic partition is research adaptation, not Chinese manure measurement
manure.boundary: HaNi field-applied N only; no second excretion or field-application fraction

crop_residue.evidence: Shao2023 South China direct return fraction; applied to historical whole-basin crops as research scenario. Complement includes unresolved removal/burning/grazing destinations, not all harvested feed.
crop_residue.root_residue: not quantified by aboveground Dryad residue; excluded unknown, not zero observation

plant.evidence: Vergutz2012 global leaf N resorption mean, abstract-level evidence; applied to leaf only
plant.organ_evidence: Pinned CTSM allocation table temperate BET and C3 grass; LUH forest/nonforest mapping is an adaptation
plant.turnover_scenario: one annual cohort leaf/root reference; current-year annual NPP allocation, root all returned, non-resorbed leaf returned, wood retained; not a CTSM simulation

available_loss_identity: explicit no-unidentified-extra-loss reference; no literature support for one universal PRB loss rate. River removal retained. This is a bounding research configuration, not calibrated chemistry.
deposition_calendar_limitation: All months uniformly disaggregated. Does not close positive-wet/zero-H1-rain conflict in strict H1 calendar; cannot be certified as true daily deposition.
surface_policy: urban and unassigned deposition held in explicit passive quarantine; no plant, soil reaction or release there. This bounding retention policy does not estimate urban wash-off.
land_transition_policy: conservative_relocation_scenario; mass entering urban is retained inert, no fabricated conversion release
NPP_QC_policy: all numeric valid MOD17 values with QC recorded; quality percentages are not bit flags; valid-support mean extrapolated explicitly to LUH forest/nonforest areas
NPP_history_policy: 1961-2000 uses 2001-2020 reach vegetation-specific mean density as labeled scenario; no claim of independent historical production
NPP_missing_class_policy: same year basin vegetation-group valid-area weighted mean if reach group absent; donor identity recorded
crop_calendar: annual sources and plant activity uniformly spread to avoid inventing application or harvest dates; does not add observed daily dynamics
excluded_unknown_sources: unrepresented legume BNF in Others crops
root residue not in Dryad aboveground product
CCD_role: independent partial-crop support diagnostic; not summed into the driver until cross-province footprints are resolved
H1: unchanged F23_U mobilization/fast allocation/routing; old M lifetime and source correction not transplanted
